# MUS

> MUS is an open-source React component library that adds a two-way feedback
> layer to any section of a product. Users react in context, right where the
> output lives. Teams add explanations that stay. One component, no forms, no
> backend to write.

MUS (`@datachef/mus` on npm) is built by DataChef, a Netherlands-based data and
AI consultancy. It is aimed at AI products with a web face: when an output needs
to be questioned, explained or challenged, that should happen on the screen
where it appeared — not in a form and not in a meeting.

## How it is used

Wrap any output in `<FeedbackTarget>` inside a `<MusProvider>`. Hovering the
output reveals a toolbar in place: reactions, a support message, a voice note.
Feedback is routed to Slack, Discord, Microsoft Teams, or a webhook of your own.

```tsx
import { MusProvider, FeedbackTarget } from '@datachef/mus'
import '@datachef/mus/styles.css'
```
